fields.name: cnt
fields.description: A count of distinct patients matching the row's dimension values
fields.details: COUNT(DISTINCT research_id) with true, unrounded values. Cells with fewer than 10 patients are removed from the file, so every value is at least 10 (range 10 to 10,000). A missing row means the true count was 1 to 9 or the combination does not occur. Rows are not additive: a parent count can exceed the sum of its kept children. An all-blank row holds the cohort total of 10,000.

fields.name: event_free_survival_years
fields.description: Whole years from diagnosis to the first event or to censoring
fields.details: Floor of days divided by 365, capped at 5 and shown as >=5 (6 levels: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, >=5). Patients: 0 (5,311), 1 (2,243), 2 (1,246), 3 (589), 4 (323), >=5 (288). An empty field means the dimension is rolled up in that row, never missing data. Every year level has at least 10 patients, so each has a one-dimension row.

fields.name: efs_status
fields.description: What ended follow-up. Any value other than Censored is an event
fields.details: Steroid rescue: first corticosteroid use after induction. Escalation or surgery: first escalation to a different drug class, or surgery. Censored: follow-up ended with no event. Induction steroids are not events. Values: Steroid rescue, Escalation or surgery, Censored.

fields.name: age_at_initial_diagnosis_years
fields.description: Whole years of age at IBD diagnosis
fields.details: Floor of age in days divided by 365. Values 0 to 17. Ages 0 to 5 are the very-early-onset cohort (593 patients) and ages 6 to 17 the pediatric cohort (9,407 patients). Cohort is not a separate column. Counts rise from 47 patients at age 0 to about 1,280 at ages 15 and 16, following the pediatric module's weights for ages 6 to 17 extended downward by assumption.

fields.name: firstline_therapy
fields.description: The first drug class started after diagnosis
fields.details: Corticosteroid is not an option; steroid use is modeled as an event. Values: AMINOSALICYLATE, IMMUNOMODULATOR, ANTI_TNF, ANTI_INTERLEUKIN, ANTI_INTEGRIN, JAK_INHIBITOR. Anti-interleukin, anti-integrin and JAK inhibitor starts are off-label and rare (JAK inhibitor has 83 patients, so most of its cells are suppressed).

fields.name: ibd_subtype
fields.details: Values: Crohn's Disease, Ulcerative Colitis, IBD-Unclassified.

fields.name: severity
fields.details: Values: Mild, Moderate, Severe. For pediatric Crohn's disease, perianal disease, stricturing or penetrating behavior, or growth failure sets severity to Severe; for pediatric colitis it follows PUCAI at consult.

fields.name: perianal_disease
fields.details: Assessed for Crohn's disease only. Not Applicable is a structural value for Ulcerative Colitis and IBD-Unclassified, not missing data. Values: Yes (614), No (4,635), Not Applicable (4,751). Pediatric Crohn's uses the module rate of 12%. Very-early-onset Crohn's uses an assumed 20%. Descriptive only in the very-early-onset cohort.
